canon.note: Sparxie is an Elation-path Fire character (Energy limit 160). Skill 150102 Boom! livestream up (Engagement Farming): spends 1 SP, +30 Energy, opens the livestream for #1 Engagement triggers. While the livestream is up, Basic ATK 150101 becomes the Enhanced Bloom (main + adjacent) and each use adds an Engagement-Farming Elation instance. A4 Dazzling! Persona Kaleidoscope adds Punchline/Thrill on Ult by Elation-ally count. Sleight Elation DMG is produced by Certified Banger and deals nothing without CB.

fixtures.env: Sparxie E0 solo vs a Fire-weak Elite (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7
Sparxie E6 solo vs the same Elite - #BuiltDifferent #GoingExtinct grants All-Type RES PEN +20% for the battle

requirements.claim: Talent 150104: for every Engagement Farming instance triggered, the Enhanced Basic deals one extra Fire Elation DMG instance to a random attacked enemy ('Sleight (stream k/n)', elation.ts:140-143).
Basic ATK Bloom (main) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Boom! livestream up (150102, Engagement Farming) is Sparxie's Skill action.
Party's Wildin' (150103) is Sparxie's Ultimate action.
While the livestream is up, Basic ATK becomes the Enhanced Bloom (150101) as a Blast - main target hit.
The Enhanced Bloom also strikes the adjacent target.
Party's Wildin' deals a Fire hit to every enemy.
Sleight is Certified-Banger-produced: once CB is held (granted in-battle), Party's Wildin' adds a Sleight (Ult) Elation hit after its main Fire hit.
While holding CB, the Enhanced Bloom adds its Sleight (main) Elation hit.
E6 #BuiltDifferent #GoingExtinct grants Sparxie All-Type RES PEN +20% for the battle (sparxie_e6).
Sparxie opens the livestream with her Skill before the first Enhanced Bloom Basic.
Sparxie's Ultimate gate is the 160-Energy ladder; she never exceeds it.
